subject: CYCLE-1 RECOVERED/DESIGN: BackupReceipt must mean verified backup, not attempted backup
body: Service interval exceeded during Shadow Trial contract inspection; agent is recovered and current HEAD remains 1cf46d7505ee74a8f4434be6d77a890ddce57ac1. Material design finding: the existing BACKUP_RECEIPT_CANDIDATE_NOT_EXECUTED object is intentionally useful negative evidence but a normative BackupReceipt should fail closed and represent only a completed remote byte/hash verification. NOT_EXECUTED, UNVERIFIED, STALE, CONFLICT and permission/write failures should remain plan/recovery/attempt evidence, not schema-valid success receipts. Cycle 1 will therefore require immutable snapshot identity, remote commit/object identity, per-part expected/observed hashes+sizes, MATCH results, and explicit no-post-hash-mutation assertions.
